hypothesis.statement: On real Empatica-E4 EDA (PhysioNet Non-EEG, Subject 1), PhysioEDA's highpass phasic/tonic split reproduces NeuroKit2's highpass split like-for-like (phasic r ~0.96, tonic r ~1.0).

analysis_plan.dataset: PhysioNet Non-EEG (Birjandtalab 2016), Subject 1 EDA channel, Empatica E4 @ 8 Hz, 18343 samples

decision.threshold: descriptive: correlation of PhysioEDA vs NeuroKit2 phasic/tonic components (matched highpass method)
